articles.title: 从原料输出到加工增值 海南自贸港政策赋能屯昌橡胶产业升级
articles.highlight: 一批105吨、货值约130万元的越南浓缩乳胶运抵屯昌，启动精深加工。
articles.summary: 文章称，10月17日一批105吨、货值约130万元的越南浓缩乳胶运抵屯昌县海南翊沣农业科技有限公司乳胶丝项目厂区，启动精深加工，原料依托加工增值30%内销免关税政策进口。待加工增值达标并实现内销后，这标志着屯昌从“原料输出腹地”向“加工增值高地”转变，也是海南自贸港核心政策在县域实体经济场景的精准应用。值得读的地方在于，它展示自贸港政策如何落到具体县域产业项目上。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点是项目能否形成可持续的加工增值链条并满足内销条件；现有信息只说明首批原料到厂，后续达标与内销进展仍需观察。

articles.title: Brazilian Amazon deforestation falls to lowest on record as pivotal vote looms
articles.highlight: 巴西政府最新数据显示，亚马逊森林砍伐量已降至自1988年有记录以来的最低水平。
articles.summary: 文章基于巴西政府最新公布的数据称，亚马逊森林砍伐总量创下有记录以来最低，这对现任总统卢拉而言是一项成果。但这一全球瞩目的成效能否延续，取决于10月25日总统决选的结果——两位候选人对雨林未来以及唐纳德·特朗普治下巴美关系的设想截然不同。对非技术读者而言，它展示了环境治理成果如何与政治周期紧密绑定，政策可能在一次投票后转向。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：这类“创纪录”的治理成果往往缺少制度性保障，其可持续性取决于选举结果与执政者意愿，而非技术或数据的惯性。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Forest clearance at smallest total since records began in 1988 in success for Lula ahead of presidential run-off Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows. But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump.

en.highlight: New government data shows deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began in 1988.
en.summary: Citing new government figures, the article reports that total forest clearance in the Brazilian Amazon is the lowest since records began, a success for President Lula. Whether that globally significant outcome holds or reverses hinges on the 25 October presidential runoff between two candidates with sharply different visions for the rainforest and for relations with the US under Donald Trump. For a non-technical reader, it shows how environmental governance results are tied to political cycles and can shift after a single vote.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: record-breaking governance outcomes often lack institutional safeguards, so their durability depends on election results and the will of officeholders rather than on data or technical momentum.

articles.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
articles.highlight: 但过夜住宿往往只能靠家属自己解决，他们常常只能睡在街上。
articles.summary: 在德里，患者常长途跋涉到公立医院就医，符合条件的可获得医疗费用援助。但过夜住宿通常要家属自行解决，许多人只能露宿街头。报道让人看到公共医疗之外被忽视的陪护成本与安置压力。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：医疗援助若只覆盖诊疗费用，而不考虑陪护者的住宿与安置，就会把一部分成本转嫁给最脆弱的家庭。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.

en.highlight: But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
en.summary: In Delhi, patients often travel long distances to public hospitals, and those in need can receive financial aid for care. Overnight accommodation, however, is usually left to families, many of whom end up sleeping on the street. The report highlights the overlooked costs and burdens of caregiving beyond medical treatment.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: if medical aid covers treatment costs but not caregivers’ shelter and basic accommodation, part of the burden is shifted onto the most vulnerable families.

articles.title: The ladder of knowledge
articles.highlight: 我们所宣称的“真”，并不是一个永远够不到的天花板，而是随着我们攀登而改变的东西。
articles.summary: 这篇 Aeon 文章以“知识阶梯”为线索，讨论一个世纪以来人们对知识边界的寻找。它提醒读者：我们所说的“真”不是固定终点，会随着认知攀升而变化，因此值得重新理解知识边界。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发在于：不要把当前认知当作绝对天花板；真正可靠的知识观，应当承认相关标准会随着探索的推进而被修正。
articles.sourceExcerpt: What we claim as ‘true’ is not a ceiling we are forever failing to reach but something that changes as we climb toward it - by Alexander V Gheorghiu Read on Aeon

en.highlight: What we claim as ‘true’ is not a ceiling we are forever failing to reach but something that changes as we climb toward it.
en.summary: This Aeon essay examines a century-long search for the limits of knowledge. It argues that what we call “true” is not a fixed ceiling but something that changes as we climb toward it, making the idea of a knowledge boundary worth reconsidering.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is not to treat current understanding as an absolute ceiling; a sound view of knowledge accepts that standards can be revised as inquiry advances.

articles.sourceExcerpt: NEURODETR: MULTISCALEDISCRETESPATIOTEM- PORALTOKENIZATION FORASYNCHRONOUSEEG EVENTDETECTION Yaozhi Wen1,2,3, Kun Zhao1,4, Wei Wei1, Haoyang Chen3,5, Kangning Wang1, Yi Sun1,3,4, Shaowei Gu1,2,3, Dingkun Liu3,6, Shuang Qiu1,*, and Huiguang He1,2,3,4,* 1Laboratory of Brain Atlas and Brain-Inspired Intelligence, State Key Laboratory of Brain Cognition and Brain-inspired Intelligence Technology, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences 2School of Future Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences 3Zhongguancun Academy 4School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences 5Wuhan University 6Hubei Key Laboratory of Brain-inspired Intelligent Systems, School of Artificial Intelligence and Automation, Huazhong University of Science and Technology *Corresponding authors {wenyaozhi2024, shuang.qiu, huiguang.he}@ia.ac.cn ABSTRACT Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing back- ground activity. To address this, we proposeNeuroDETR, a discrete spatiotem- poral multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event- aware feature refinement.
